cues.en: Fanning fire with piece of Eucalyptus bark
Lashing together with strip of bark fiber
Making a fan housing from clay

cues.zh: 外壳上的孔应与出风口上的孔大小一致
cues.en: Hole in housing should be same size as hole in spout

cues.zh: 放在火边的小屋里晾干
cues.en: Drying in hut next to fire

cues.zh: 空气现在从外壳顶部吸入，并向火的方向吹出
cues.en: Air is now sucked through top of housing and is blown out towards the fire

cues.zh: 无论朝哪个方向旋转，风扇始终向外吹风
cues.en: Fan always blows air regardless of which way it spins

cues.zh: 现在空气被直接送入燃料床
cues.en: Now air is forced directly into fuel bed
Lashing crossbar on with lawyer cane

cues.zh: 绳子系在棍子上，并绕在风扇转子上
cues.en: Cord is attached to stick and looped around fan rotor

cues.zh: 转子现在转得更轻松、更快了
cues.en: Rotor spins easier and faster now

cues.zh: 铁细菌常见于小溪、沼泽和泉水中
cues.en: Iron bacteria is commonly found in creeks, swamps and springs

cues.zh: 加入碎木炭以将矿石还原为铁，并加入白色木灰以降低矿石的熔点
cues.en: Crushed charcoal is added to reduce the ore to iron and white wood ash is added to lower the melting point of the ore
The ingredients are formed into a brick

cues.zh: 上一个视频留下的木炭
从炉中拉出熔化的物质
炉渣中几粒微小的铁金属
cues.en: A few tiny specks of iron metal from the slag
